SELECT DISTINCT OWNER.LOC,
    CON.PERSON_UID,
    VEH.LCNS_NUM,
    VEH.X_LAND_TRNS_BUR_NAME,--changed for 22177
    VEH.X_CLASSIFICATION_NUM,
    VEH.X_REG_NUM_JAP_KANA,
    VEH.X_REG_NUM_SERIAL_NUM,
    VEH.SERIAL_NUM,
    VEH.X_STMPD_VHCL_NUM,
    VEH.X_VHCL_NUM_MNU_NUM,
    OWNER.NAME,--Changed for Defect 22176
    ADDR.X_ZIPCODE,
    trim(STA.VAL    
    ||ADDR.X_CITY    
    ||ADDR.X_OAZA    
    ||ADDR.X_AZA    
    ||ADDR.X_BLOCK_NUM    
    ||ADDR.X_BLDG_NM_ROOM_NUM) ,--Changed for Defect 22176
    '',
    TO_CHAR(VEH.REGISTERED_DT,'YYYYMM'),
    TO_CHAR(VEH.REGISTERED_DT,'YYYY'),
    TO_CHAR(VEH.REGISTERED_DT,'MM'),
    TO_CHAR(VEH.END_DT,'YYYY'),
    TO_CHAR(VEH.END_DT,'MM'),
    TO_CHAR(VEH.END_DT,'DD'),
    BRAND.VAL,
    VEHTYPE.VAL,
    VEHCL.VAL,
    BCL.VAL,
    FIN.NAME,--changed as per Logesh Confirmation 10/1/2019
    OWNER.MAIN_PH_NUM,
    SERV.LOC,
    SERV.NAME,
    POSCON.EMP_NUM,
    POSCON.LAST_NAME,
    TO_CHAR(JC.CREATED,'YYYYMMDD'),
    JC.ODOMTR_RDNG,
    JC.SR_NUM,
    DEALER.LOC,
    JC.X_WORKSHOP_CODE,
    SOBR.NAME,
    OPTYCR.EMP_NUM,
    ORDCR.LAST_NAME,
    VEH.X_REG_MODEL_CODE,
    VEH.X_STAMP_ENGINE_MDCODE,
    VEHX.X_CLASS,
    USRBR.LOC,--changed for 22177
    FINBRANCH.NAME,
    FINXM.ATTRIB_49,
    FINXM.ATTRIB_41,
    '',
    '',
    VEH.X_LAND_TRNS_BUR_CODE,
    '',
    VEH.LCNS_NUM,
    TO_CHAR(VEHX.X_SCRAP_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),
    TO_CHAR(VEH.LAST_UPD,'YYYYMMDD'),
    TO_CHAR(VEH.REGISTERED_DT,'YYYYMMDD'),
    '',
    VEH.SERIAL_NUM,
    '',
    '',
    VEH.X_STMPD_VHCL_NUM,
    trim(ADDPR.X_PRFCTUR_CD1	
    ||ADDPR.X_CTY_CNTY_CD1	
    ||ADDPR.X_OOAZA_CD1	
    ||ADDPR.X_AZA_CD1),--Changed for Defect 22176/removed field seperator for CR 22177
    ADDR.X_ZIPCODE,
    '',
    VEHTYPE.VAL,
    BRAND.VAL,
    OWNER.NAME,--Changed for Defect 22176
    trim(STA.VAL    
    ||ADDR.X_CITY    
    ||ADDR.X_OAZA    
    ||ADDR.X_AZA    
    ||ADDR.X_BLOCK_NUM    
    ||ADDR.X_BLDG_NM_ROOM_NUM),--Changed for Defect 22176
    '',
    VEHX.X_VHCL_INS_FLG,
    VEHX.ATTRIB_40,
    VEH.status_cd,
    VEH.sub_status_cd,
 VEH.X_VEHICLE_TYPE_CODE
  FROM SIEBEL.S_ASSET VEH,
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT OWNER,
    SIEBEL.S_CONTACT CON,
    (SELECT ACCNT_ID,ADDR_PER_ID,X_STATE,X_CITY,X_OAZA,X_AZA,X_BLOCK_NUM,X_BLDG_NM_ROOM_NUM,X_ZIPCODE FROM 
(SELECT ACCNT_ID,ADDR_PER_ID,X_STATE,X_CITY,X_OAZA,X_AZA,X_BLOCK_NUM,X_BLDG_NM_ROOM_NUM,X_ZIPCODE,
 DENSE_RANK() over (partition BY ACCNT_ID,ADDR_PER_ID order by CREATED DESC) rank1
 FROM SIEBEL.S_CON_ADDR )
 WHERE rank1=1) ADDR,
 SIEBEL.S_ADDR_PER ADDPR,--Changed for Defect 22176
    SIEBEL.S_ASSET_X VEHX,
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT SERV,
    SIEBEL.S_POSTN POSTN,
    SIEBEL.S_CONTACT POSCON,
    --SIEBEL.S_VHCL_SRV SRV,
    --SIEBEL.S_SRV_REQ SR,
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT DEALER,
    --SIEBEL.S_ORDER SO,
    --SIEBEL.S_ORDER_TYPE SOP,
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT SOBR,
    SIEBEL.S_OPTY OPTY,
    SIEBEL.S_CONTACT OPTYCR,
    SIEBEL.S_CONTACT ORDCR,
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT FIN,
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT_XM FINXM,
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT FINBRANCH,
    SIEBEL.S_LST_OF_VAL BRAND,
    SIEBEL.S_LST_OF_VAL VEHTYPE,
    SIEBEL.S_LST_OF_VAL VEHCL,
    SIEBEL.S_LST_OF_VAL BCL,
    SIEBEL.S_LST_OF_VAL STA,--Changed for Defect 22176
    SIEBEL.S_USER USR,--Changed for 22177
    SIEBEL.S_CONTACT CONUSR,--Changed for 22177
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT USRBR,--Changed for 22177
    (SELECT CREATED,
      VHCL_ID,
      ODOMTR_RDNG,
      SR_NUM,
      BU_ID,
      X_WORKSHOP_CODE
    FROM
      (SELECT SR.CREATED,
        SRV.VHCL_ID,
        SR.ODOMTR_RDNG,
        SR.SR_NUM,
        SR.BU_ID,
        SRV.X_WORKSHOP_CODE ,
        DENSE_RANK() over (partition BY SRV.VHCL_ID order by SR.created DESC) rank1
      FROM SIEBEL.S_VHCL_SRV SRV,
        SIEBEL.S_SRV_REQ SR
      WHERE SR.SR_CAT_TYPE_CD='Job Card'
      AND SR.ROW_ID          =SRV.SRV_REQ_ID
      )
    WHERE rank1=1
    ) JC,
    (SELECT A.BU_ID,
      A.ROW_ID,
      A.OPTY_ID,
      A.X_VEHICLE_ID,
      A.CREATED_BY
    FROM SIEBEL.S_ORDER A,
      SIEBEL.S_ORDER_TYPE B
    WHERE A.ORDER_TYPE_ID=B.ROW_ID
    AND B.NAME           = 'Sales Order'
    AND A.STATUS_CD      = 'Sales Posting Completed'
    )SO
  WHERE VEH.TYPE_CD          ='Vehicle'
  AND VEH.X_USR_ONR_ACC_ID   =OWNER.ROW_ID(+)
  AND VEH.X_BILL_CONT_CD     =CON.ROW_ID(+)
  AND OWNER.ROW_ID           =ADDR.ACCNT_ID(+)
  AND ADDR.ADDR_PER_ID = ADDPR.ROW_ID(+)
  AND VEH.ROW_ID             =VEHX.PAR_ROW_ID(+)
  AND VEH.PREF_SRV_DLR_ID    =SERV.ROW_ID(+)
  AND VEH.PR_POSTN_ID        =POSTN.ROW_ID(+)
  AND POSTN.PR_EMP_ID        =POSCON.ROW_ID(+)
  AND VEH.ROW_ID             =JC.VHCL_ID(+)
  AND JC.BU_ID               =DEALER.ROW_ID(+)
  AND VEH.ROW_ID             =SO.X_VEHICLE_ID(+)
  AND SO.OPTY_ID             =OPTY.ROW_ID(+)
  AND OPTY.CREATED_BY        =OPTYCR.ROW_ID(+)
  AND SO.CREATED_BY          =ORDCR.ROW_ID(+)
  AND SO.BU_ID               =SOBR.ROW_ID(+)
  AND OWNER.ROW_ID           =FIN.PAR_OU_ID(+)
  AND FIN.ROW_ID=FINXM.PAR_ROW_ID(+)
  AND FINXM.ATTRIB_48        =FINBRANCH.X_4_DIGIT_CD(+)
  AND FINXM.NAME(+)          ='NV Responsible'
  AND FIN.ACCNT_TYPE_CD(+)   ='Finance'
  AND FINXM.ATTRIB_42= USR.LOGIN(+)--Changed for 22177
  AND USR.ROW_ID=CONUSR.ROW_ID(+)--Changed for 22177
  AND CONUSR.BU_ID= USRBR.ROW_ID(+)--Changed for 22177
  AND VEH.MAKE_CD            =BRAND.NAME(+)
  AND BRAND.TYPE(+)          ='AUTO_MAKE_TYPE'
  AND BRAND.LANG_ID(+)       ='JPN'
  AND VEH.X_VEHICLE_TYPE_CODE=VEHTYPE.NAME(+)
  AND VEHTYPE.TYPE(+)        ='MF_VEHICLE_TYPE'
  AND VEHTYPE.LANG_ID(+)     ='JPN'
  AND VEHX.X_VHCL_INS_CLS    =VEHCL.NAME(+)
  AND VEHCL.TYPE(+)          ='MF_VEH_INS_CLS'
  AND VEHCL.LANG_ID(+)       ='JPN'
  AND VEHTYPE.ACTIVE_FLG = 'Y'
  AND VEHX.X_BSNS_CLS        =BCL.NAME(+)
  AND BCL.TYPE(+)            ='BUSINESS_CLS'
  AND BCL.LANG_ID(+)         ='JPN'
  AND ADDR.X_STATE = STA.NAME(+)--Changed for Defect 22176
  AND STA.TYPE(+)= 'MF_PREF_KANJI'--Changed for Defect 22176
  AND STA.LANG_ID(+) = 'JPN'
  AND VEH.status_cd not in ('Permanent Deregistration(EOL)')
  AND VEH.sub_status_cd not in ('Permanent Deregistration')

sql:
select * from (
WITH AR_ADDRESS AS (
    SELECT 
        PAR_ROW_ID,
        LAST_UPD,
        ATTRIB_38,
        ATTRIB_41,
        ATTRIB_03,
        ATTRIB_39,
        ATTRIB_48,
        ATTRIB_02,
        ATTRIB_01,
        ATTRIB_36,
        ATTRIB_35,
        ATTRIB_34,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PAR_ROW_ID ORDER BY LAST_UPD DESC) AS RN
    FROM 
        SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT_XM
    WHERE 
        TYPE = 'AR Address'
),
AP_ADDRESS AS (
    SELECT 
        PAR_ROW_ID,
        LAST_UPD,
        ATTRIB_03,
        ATTRIB_36,
        ATTRIB_35,
        ATTRIB_34,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PAR_ROW_ID ORDER BY LAST_UPD DESC) AS RN
    FROM 
        SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT_XM
    WHERE 
        TYPE = 'AP Address'
),
NV_RESPONSIBLE AS (
    SELECT 
        PAR_ROW_ID,
        LAST_UPD,
        ATTRIB_48,
        ATTRIB_49,
        ATTRIB_41,
        ATTRIB_03,
        ATTRIB_36,
        ATTRIB_47,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PAR_ROW_ID ORDER BY LAST_UPD DESC) AS RN
    FROM 
        SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT_XM
    WHERE 
        TYPE = 'NV Responsible'
),
UV_RESPONSIBLE AS (
    SELECT 
        PAR_ROW_ID,
        LAST_UPD,
        ATTRIB_48,
        ATTRIB_49,
        ATTRIB_41,
        ATTRIB_03,
        ATTRIB_36,
        ATTRIB_47,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PAR_ROW_ID ORDER BY LAST_UPD DESC) AS RN
    FROM 
        SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT_XM
    WHERE 
        TYPE = 'UV Responsible'
),
PARTS_RESPONSIBLE AS (
    SELECT 
        PAR_ROW_ID,
        LAST_UPD,
        ATTRIB_48,
        ATTRIB_49,
        ATTRIB_41,
        ATTRIB_03,
        ATTRIB_36,
        ATTRIB_47,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PAR_ROW_ID ORDER BY LAST_UPD DESC) AS RN
    FROM 
        SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT_XM
    WHERE 
        TYPE = 'Parts Responsible'
),
SERVICE_RESPONSIBLE AS (
    SELECT 
        PAR_ROW_ID,
        LAST_UPD,
        ATTRIB_48,
        ATTRIB_49,
        ATTRIB_41,
        ATTRIB_03,
        ATTRIB_36,
        ATTRIB_47,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PAR_ROW_ID ORDER BY LAST_UPD DESC) AS RN
    FROM 
        SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT_XM
    WHERE 
        TYPE = 'Service Responsible'
)
SELECT DISTINCT

      T1.loc as CUSTOMER_CODE,
      T1.NAME as CUSTOMER_NAME,
      REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(T1.X_CMP_NM_KANA), CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '') as CUSTOMER_NAME_KANA,
      SUBSTR(T31.X_ZIPCODE, 1, 3) || '-' || SUBSTR(T31.X_ZIPCODE, 4, length(T31.X_ZIPCODE)-3) AS ZIP_CODE,
      (T33.val ||' '|| T32.X_CNT_CTY_NM_KNJ ||' '|| T32.ADDR_LINE_3 ||' '|| T32.ADDR_LINE_4 || ' ' || T31.X_BLOCK_NUM ||' '|| T31.X_BLDG_NM_ROOM_NUM) as CUSTOMER_ADDRESS,
      T2.MAIN_PH_NUM as TEL_NUM,
--      REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(T2.X_SAP_CD), CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '') as CUSTOMER_CODE, 
--      REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(T2.X_CMP_NM_ENG), CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '') as CUSTOMER_NAME_E,
--      REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(T2.NAME), CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '') as CUSTOMER_NAME_KANA, 
--      T31.X_ZIPCODE as ZIP_CODE,
--   T33.VAL as PREFECTURE_NAME,
--      --T32.X_PRFCTUR_CD1 as PREFECTURE_CODE,
--   T32.X_CNT_CTY_NM_KNJ as CITY_COUNTY_NAME,
--      T32.ADDR_LINE_3 AS OOAZA_Name,
--      T32.ADDR_LINE_4 as AZA_CHOME,
--   T31.X_BLOCK_NUM as BLOCK_NUM,
--      T31.X_BLDG_NM_ROOM_NUM as BUILD_NAME_ROOM_NUM,
--      T2.MAIN_PH_NUM as TEL_NUM,

      REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(T25.ATTRIB_48), CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '') as RESPONSBLE_SERVICE_SHOP_CODE,
      REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(T25.ATTRIB_49), CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '') as RESPONSBLE_SERVICE_CODE,
      REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(T25.ATTRIB_41), CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '') as RESPONSBLE_SERVICE_NAME,
      REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(T25.ATTRIB_03), CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '') as RESPONSBLE_SERVICE_TEL,
   REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(T22.ATTRIB_48), CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '') as RESPONSBLE_NV_SHOP_CODE,
      REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(T22.ATTRIB_49), CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '') as RESPONSBLE_NV_CODE,
      REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(T22.ATTRIB_41), CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '') as RESPONSBLE_NV_NAME,
      REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(T22.ATTRIB_03), CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '') as RESPONSBLE_NV_TEL,
      (SELECT VAL FROM SIEBEL.S_LST_OF_VAL WHERE TYPE = 'MF_RISK_RANK' AND NAME = T4.X_RISK_RANK  OFFSET 1 ROW FETCH NEXT 1 ROW ONLY) AS "RISK_RANK",
      CASE REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(T4.X_ANTI_SOCIETY_CATEGORY), CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '') 
        WHEN 'N' THEN 'No'
        WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Yes'
      END as SPN_CHECK,   
      REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM((CASE T4.X_NO_BUS_LT_FLG WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Yes' WHEN 'N' THEN 'No' ELSE 'No' END)), CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '') as LONGTIME_TRANS_CUSTOMER,
      REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM((CASE T4.X_SLS_CAT_MNTNCE WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Yes' WHEN 'N' THEN 'No' ELSE 'No' END)), CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '') as MODULE_FLG_SV
FROM 
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT T1
LEFT OUTER JOIN 
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT T2 ON T1.ROW_ID = T2.PAR_OU_ID
    AND T2.ACCNT_TYPE_CD in ('Finance')
LEFT JOIN 
    AR_ADDRESS T3 ON T2.ROW_ID = T3.PAR_ROW_ID AND T3.RN = 1
LEFT JOIN 
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT_X T4 ON T2.ROW_ID = T4.PAR_ROW_ID AND T4.X_SLS_CAT_ALL = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN 
    SIEBEL.S_LST_OF_VAL LOV ON LOV.VAL = T4.X_ACCOUNT_TYPE AND LOV.TYPE = 'MF_VIR_ACC_TYPE'
LEFT JOIN 
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT T5 ON T1.ROW_ID = T5.PAR_OU_ID AND T5.ACCNT_TYPE_CD = 'Finance'
LEFT JOIN 
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT_X T6 ON T5.ROW_ID = T6.PAR_ROW_ID AND T6.X_PUR_CAT = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN 
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT_XM T7 ON T2.ROW_ID = T7.PAR_ROW_ID AND T7.X_PAYMENT_TYPE = 'Vehicle'
LEFT JOIN 
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT_XM T8 ON T2.ROW_ID = T8.PAR_ROW_ID AND T8.TYPE = 'AR Payment Terms' AND T8.X_PAYMENT_TYPE = 'Customer Service'
LEFT JOIN 
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT_XM T9 ON T5.ROW_ID = T9.PAR_ROW_ID AND T9.TYPE = 'AP Payment Terms' AND T9.X_PAYMENT_TYPE = 'Purchasing'
LEFT JOIN 
    AP_ADDRESS T10 ON T2.ROW_ID = T10.PAR_ROW_ID AND T10.RN = 1
LEFT JOIN 
    SIEBEL.S_PARTY T11 ON T11.ROW_ID = T2.PAR_ROW_ID
LEFT JOIN 
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT_XM T12 ON T11.ROW_ID = T12.PAR_ROW_ID AND T12.TYPE = 'HIST1'
LEFT JOIN 
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT_XM T13 ON T11.ROW_ID = T13.PAR_ROW_ID AND T13.TYPE = 'HIST2'
LEFT JOIN 
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT_XM T14 ON T11.ROW_ID = T14.PAR_ROW_ID AND T14.TYPE = 'HIST3'
LEFT JOIN 
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT_XM T15 ON T11.ROW_ID = T15.PAR_ROW_ID AND T15.TYPE = 'HIST4'
LEFT JOIN 
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT_XM T16 ON T11.ROW_ID = T16.PAR_ROW_ID AND T16.TYPE = 'HIST5'
LEFT JOIN 
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT_FNXM T17 ON T11.ROW_ID = T17.PAR_ROW_ID AND T17.ATTRIB_04 = 'CD01'
LEFT JOIN 
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT_FNXM T18 ON T11.ROW_ID = T18.PAR_ROW_ID AND T18.ATTRIB_04 = 'CM01'
LEFT JOIN 
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT_FNXM T19 ON T11.ROW_ID = T19.PAR_ROW_ID AND T19.ATTRIB_04 = 'VM01'
LEFT JOIN 
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT_FNXM T20 ON T11.ROW_ID = T20.PAR_ROW_ID AND T20.ATTRIB_04 = 'VD01'
LEFT JOIN 
    SIEBEL.S_LST_OF_VAL T21 ON T2.X_HONORIFIC = T21.NAME AND T21.TYPE = 'MF_HONORIFIC' AND T21.LANG_ID = 'JPN'
LEFT JOIN 
    NV_RESPONSIBLE T22 ON T11.ROW_ID = T22.PAR_ROW_ID AND T22.RN = 1
LEFT JOIN 
    UV_RESPONSIBLE T23 ON T11.ROW_ID = T23.PAR_ROW_ID AND T23.RN = 1
LEFT JOIN 
    PARTS_RESPONSIBLE T24 ON T11.ROW_ID = T24.PAR_ROW_ID AND T24.RN = 1
LEFT JOIN 
    SERVICE_RESPONSIBLE T25 ON T11.ROW_ID = T25.PAR_ROW_ID AND T25.RN = 1
LEFT JOIN 
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT_XM T26 ON T11.ROW_ID = T26.PAR_ROW_ID 
    AND T26.X_PAYMENT_TYPE = 'Comp Code'
LEFT JOIN 
    SIEBEL.S_SRV_REQ T27 ON T11.ROW_ID = T27.CST_OU_ID
LEFT JOIN 
    SIEBEL.S_SRV_REQ T28 ON T2.X_CUST_ID = T28.ROW_ID
LEFT JOIN 
 SIEBEL.S_CON_ADDR T31 ON T1.X_CON_ADDR_ID = T31.ROW_ID
LEFT JOIN 
 SIEBEL.S_ADDR_PER T32 ON T31.ADDR_PER_ID = T32.ROW_ID
LEFT JOIN 
    siebel.s_lst_of_val T33 ON T33.Name  = T32.X_PRFCTUR_NM_KNJ

WHERE 
    T1.OU_TYPE_CD IN ('Company', 'Employee', 'Individual')
    AND ((T33.TYPE = 'MF_PREF_KANJI' 
    AND T33.LANG_ID = 'JPN')
    or T33.TYPE is null))

SELECT 
    distinct VEH.SERIAL_NUM as "Chassis #",
 VEH.ROW_ID AS ID,
    VEHX.ATTRIB_07 as "Authorized Re-Stamping",
    VEH.X_LAND_TRNS_BUR_NAME as "Land transport bureau name_Region name",--changed for 22177
    VEH.X_CLASSIFICATION_NUM as "Classification",
    VEH.X_REG_NUM_JAP_KANA AS "Japanese kana",
    VEH.X_REG_NUM_SERIAL_NUM as "Serial #",
    VEH.X_LAND_TRNS_BUR_NAME || '-' || VEH.X_CLASSIFICATION_NUM || '-' || VEH.X_REG_NUM_JAP_KANA || '-' || VEH.X_REG_NUM_SERIAL_NUM as "REGISTRATION_NO",
    --VEH.LCNS_NUM as "Registration No.",
 VEHX.X_VHCL_MNGMNT_NUM as "Vehicle management No.",
    VEHX.X_CLASS as "Class",
    TO_CHAR(VEH.REGISTERED_DT,'YYYY/MM/DD') as "Initial Registration Year Month",
    TO_CHAR(VEH.END_DT,'YYYY/MM/DD') as "Shaken Expiration Date",
    REPLACE(VEHX.X_VHCL_INS_FLG, 'year', '年') as "Inspection Span Flag",
    --VEHX.X_BSNS_CLS as "Private or Business Use Type",
    BCL.VAL as "Private or Business Use Type",
    VEHX.ATTRIB_40 as "Emmision Code",
    TO_CHAR(VEH.X_LOAD_CAPACITY) as "Load Capacity",
    TO_CHAR(VEHATX.ODOMTR_RCPT) as "Maximum Mileage",
    VEH.X_STAMP_ENGINE_MDCODE as "Engine Model Code/Number",
    SERV.LOC as "Code of Branch in charge of service",
    SERV.NAME as "Name of Branch in charge of service",
    POSCON.EMP_NUM as "Code of personnel in charge of service",
    POSCON.LAST_NAME as "Name of Personnel in charge of service",
    VEH.X_AGREE_NUM as "Contract Number",
    VEH.X_AGR_START_DT as "Contract Start",
    VEH.X_AGR_END_DT as "Contract End",
    VEHX.X_SRC_CNTRCT_CLS as "Service Type",
    --VEH.MAKE_CD as "Brand",
    BRAND.VAL as "Brand",
    VEH.X_GROSS_WEIGHT as "Gross Weight",
    VEHX.X_DE_REG_FLG as "De-Registration Flag",
    TO_CHAR(VEHX.X_DE_REG_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') as "Date Of Deregistration",
    VEHX.X_SCRAP_FLG as "Scraped Flag",
    TO_CHAR(VEHX.X_SCRAP_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD') as "Scrap Date",
    OWNER.LOC as "User",
    OWNERNEW.LOC as "Owner"
 --self-employed category
 --linked registration no.

FROM SIEBEL.S_ASSET VEH,
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT OWNER,
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT OWNERNEW,
    SIEBEL.S_CONTACT CON,
    (SELECT ACCNT_ID, ADDR_PER_ID, X_STATE, X_CITY, X_OAZA, X_AZA, X_BLOCK_NUM, X_BLDG_NM_ROOM_NUM, X_ZIPCODE 
     FROM (
         SELECT ACCNT_ID, ADDR_PER_ID, X_STATE, X_CITY, X_OAZA, X_AZA, X_BLOCK_NUM, X_BLDG_NM_ROOM_NUM, X_ZIPCODE,
         DENSE_RANK() over (PARTITION BY ACCNT_ID, ADDR_PER_ID ORDER BY CREATED DESC) rank1
         FROM SIEBEL.S_CON_ADDR
     ) 
     WHERE rank1 = 1
    ) ADDR,
    SIEBEL.S_ADDR_PER ADDPR,--Changed for Defect 22176
    SIEBEL.S_ASSET_X VEHX,
    SIEBEL.S_ASSET_ATX VEHATX,
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT SERV,
    SIEBEL.S_POSTN POSTN,
    SIEBEL.S_CONTACT POSCON,
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT DEALER,
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT SOBR,
    SIEBEL.S_OPTY OPTY,
    SIEBEL.S_CONTACT OPTYCR,
    SIEBEL.S_CONTACT ORDCR,
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT FIN,
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT_XM FINXM,
    SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT FINBRANCH,
    SIEBEL.S_LST_OF_VAL BRAND,
    SIEBEL.S_LST_OF_VAL VEHTYPE,
    --SIEBEL.S_LST_OF_VAL VEHCL,
    SIEBEL.S_LST_OF_VAL BCL,
